title: 陈媛被救
style: 写实华语短剧，自然肤色，电影感光线，浅景深，竖屏构图
music_prompt: Warm emotional orchestral ballad, soft piano and strings, gentle hopeful swell, no vocals, cinematic

characters.name: 陈媛
characters.appearance: 二十多岁女性，黑色长发略显凌乱，脸色苍白，眼眶泛红含泪，衣着皱褶有污渍

characters.name: 皮予乔
characters.appearance: 二十多岁男性，短发，身穿深色外套，衣袖略有褶皱，眼神坚定温柔

characters.name: 制服警察
characters.appearance: 成年男性，深蓝色警察制服，身姿挺拔，站在背景处

shots.image_prompt: 大特写起幅，昏暗房间里陈媛缓缓睁开双眼，随后镜头后拉，越过她的视角露出上方皮予乔熟悉的面庞，柔和顶光
shots.motion_prompt: Extreme close-up, eyes slowly open, slow pull back revealing the familiar face above her

shots.image_prompt: 大特写，陈媛的瞳孔微微放大，随即眼神慌乱地四下张望，神色惊惶
shots.motion_prompt: Tight close-up, quick nervous eye movement left to right, slight handheld shake

shots.image_prompt: 中景，陈媛环视四周，几名穿制服的警察围站在近旁，她紧绷的神情放松下来，泪水慢慢漫上眼眶
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pan across uniformed officers, then tilt back to her face relaxing, tears welling up

shots.image_prompt: 中近景，陈媛深深看一眼面前的皮予乔，随即猛地用力抱住他，嚎啕大哭，皮予乔被抱得微微后仰
shots.motion_prompt: Sudden embrace, camera pulls back slightly, emotional sobbing movement

shots.image_prompt: 过肩近景，越陈媛肩膀拍皮予乔紧紧回抱她，手掌在她后背轻柔拍哄，低头贴近她耳边
shots.motion_prompt: Over-shoulder shot, gentle back-patting, slight slow sway

shots.image_prompt: 近景，皮予乔侧脸贴在陈媛耳旁，放缓声音低声安慰，神情温柔笃定，暖光映在脸上
shots.motion_prompt: Close profile shot, lips moving softly, warm light flicker
shots.speaker: 皮予乔

shots.image_prompt: 特写，皮予乔低头看她，眼神坚定而柔软，轻声继续安慰，眼角微微泛红
shots.motion_prompt: Slow tilt up to his eyes, subtle nod while speaking
shots.speaker: 皮予乔

shots.image_prompt: 近景，皮予乔收紧手臂把人搂得更稳，声音放低，像在承诺什么，侧逆光
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle pull back revealing embrace tightening, soft rim light
shots.speaker: 皮予乔

shots.image_prompt: 特写，陈媛伏在他肩头，哭过后怕与委屈渐渐退去，抹掉眼泪，呼吸仍未平复
shots.motion_prompt: Close-up, wiping tears with trembling hand, breathing gradually steadies

shots.image_prompt: 中近景，陈媛双手抓紧皮予乔的外套上下摸索查看，急切地上下打量他，哽咽着抬头
shots.motion_prompt: Handheld close shot, clutching and checking his jacket, anxious searching gaze
shots.speaker: 陈媛
shots.dialogue: 你没事吧？有没有被威胁？

shots.image_prompt: 近景，陈媛仰头紧盯着皮予乔，泪痕未干，神情又急又怕，连声追问
shots.motion_prompt: Close-up, teary eyes searching his face, urgent slight shake
shots.speaker: 陈媛

shots.image_prompt: 特写，陈媛抓着他衣袖的手微微发抖，声音哽咽往下掉，目光扫过他的手臂
shots.motion_prompt: Macro on trembling hands gripping sleeve, slow tilt to her face
shots.speaker: 陈媛

shots.image_prompt: 近景，皮予乔抬手用指尖细致整理她的额发，另一只手轻拭她面颊上的泪痕，动作轻柔
shots.motion_prompt: Two-shot close, fingers gently brushing hair from her forehead, tender slow movement

shots.image_prompt: 近景，皮予乔整理完她的额发后看着她摇头，嘴角带起一点释然的笑，语气轻快笃定
shots.motion_prompt: Close-up, slight head shake, smile spreading softly
shots.speaker: 皮予乔

shots.image_prompt: 中近景，皮予乔挺直身形扬起下巴，眼神亮起来，语气里带着一丝得意
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push in as he straightens up, chin lifting, confident posture
shots.speaker: 皮予乔
shots.dialogue: 我还把抓你的坏人给打爆了！

shots.image_prompt: 过肩镜头，越过陈媛肩膀拍皮予乔俯身看她的笑脸，两人相视，暖光渐亮，气氛松弛下来
shots.motion_prompt: Over-shoulder two shot, warm light brightening, gentle settling movement
shots.speaker: 皮予乔
